instruction: Candid action photograph, medium shot from a low angle. Outdoors on a concrete ledge under a blue sky with fluffy clouds, the man in a black t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) lies on his back with his knees bent. He supports the woman in a black crop top and denim shorts (R1) with his feet against her upper thighs. The woman (R1) stands upright, leaning forward, reaching her hands down to meet the man's (R2) raised hands. Bright natural sunlight illuminates the scene.
